quote: GPT-OSS (stylized as gpt-oss) is a set of open-weight reasoning models released by OpenAI on August 5, 2025.
note: gpt-oss-120b was released together with gpt-oss-20b as the gpt-oss set; the quoted sentence covers the set, and no separate per-model date was found. Lab and kind notes are correct (OpenAI, shipped open-weight model). The OpenAI announcement (openai.com/blog/introducing-gpt-oss, also openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-oss/) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so it was not opened; search snippets dated it August 5, 2025, but that is unverified by a fetch. Hugging Face model card (huggingface.co/openai/gpt-oss-120b) gives no release date: it shows the paper as published Aug 8, 2025 and the collection as updated Aug 7, 2025, which are not the release date. Google Cloud Vertex AI lists August 13, 2025 for its managed hosting of the model; that is a later hosting date, not the open-weight release. OpenRouter's page opened without a release-date field, so it does not corroborate the date.
queries: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b open-weight model release date
